Aug. 11 Mrs. Margaret Bessinger - 41 - non-Cath. husband lutherin - had nerve-break after 17yrs at same work; April 10th last her husband missed her and now for four months has been trying, heart sick to locate her. Enrolled her and himself Today.
15 Eileen Sigel - 29 - on April 20 narrowelly escaped instant death - broken legs and ribs, skull and diaphram. 7-8 weeks unconscious .... Her own doctor feard only day before yester. that she would not walk for months. Mother made a pilgrimage to Carey, Ohio yesterday .... and about the time she finished the
Page 163 1000 Hail Marys - the girl walks at home. Now here with her sis- ter they left the crutches in car.
Aug. 9 Gregory Harkins - 4 - "polio" - infantile par. in Kiefer's Dr. Robert Page - 39 - methodist - wife baptist ..... Family
Aug. 18 Pauline Marie Lowenhardt - 10 - in Kiefer Hosp ... Spinal maningitis - Father a convert from Judaism.
20 Ray J. Sullivan - 50 - drinking and neglecting family .....
21 Julia Repasky - 46 - of Canton, 0. - stroke May 13th, 1942 - Whole left side disabled. Her arm still remains helpless, though she is able to use her leg fairly well.
Marilyn Miller - 15 -(of Gr. Rapids) had accident in Eye last June and so far has lost the sight in that Eye .....
Veronica Tomkowiak - 44 - stroke last March; quite helpless since.
